review:
A sparkly 25-line follow-up to Miss Cherry Fruits. The Disco Ball Respin lights up the reels and uses disco ball symbols to award three different jackpots.

There are regular free spins and wilds too, and they come round often – about once every 98 spins. Medium-low volatility with a 1,299x cap. The RTP is lower at 94.65%. Built on the same base as Monster Hunt.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 98 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
